sections.title: Rabbits
sections.note: Ten per realm. Whistle to make them jump, shoot their rock (or barrel at sea) with the Cannon and catch them with the Rabbit Net within 10 seconds.

items.name: South of Rabbitland Rescue
items.howTo: Leaving Rabbitland Rescue southwards, behind the rock at the corner just before the tracks re-enter the woods (west side).

items.name: Between Aboda and Whittleton
items.howTo: East of Aboda Village where the line turns north towards Whittleton, behind a rock on the east side near the corner.

items.name: West of Castle Town
items.area: By the lake near Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: West of Castle Town on the north side of the tracks, by the lake near Hyrule Castle.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough puts it in the north-west corner of the castle area, its rabbit page west of Castle Town.

items.name: Forest Temple approach
items.howTo: In the clearing on the right (east) of the tracks as you approach the Forest Temple.

items.name: West of Anouki Village
items.howTo: Just west of Anouki Village on the north side of the tracks.
items.notes: StrategyWiki lists one south of the village near Warp Gate A instead.

items.name: North-east of Anouki Village
items.area: Snow Sanctuary to Anouki Village line
items.howTo: Leaving the Snow Sanctuary, take the first right towards Anouki Village: on the west side of the tracks.

items.name: East of the Snow Temple
items.howTo: From the Snow Temple take the first path east, then right at the next fork: on the east side.

items.name: South of the Snow Temple
items.howTo: Head straight south from the Snow Temple; where you can't go further south it's on the west side.

items.name: Middle of the old blizzard
items.howTo: Of the four east-west tracks in the middle of the old blizzard, the third from the top, on its south side.

items.name: East of the old blizzard
items.howTo: From the rabbit east of the temple go a little south and take the east path: on the north side.

items.name: South-east of the old blizzard
items.howTo: At the south-east corner of the old blizzard area, on the east side of the tracks.

items.name: South of the Trading Post
items.howTo: On the last curve before the Trading Post, behind a rock over a hill to the south. Easier from Carben's new tracks by Warp Gate B.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki lists Carben's Force Gem as its prerequisite; Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough says it can be shot from the main line already.

items.name: East of the Ocean Sanctuary
items.howTo: East of the Ocean Sanctuary, behind a floating barrel on the south side.

items.name: Further east
items.howTo: East of the previous rabbit, on the north side.

items.name: North of the eastern islands
items.howTo: North of the previous rabbit, on the north side.

items.name: North-east corner
items.howTo: In the north-east of the Ocean Realm, on the south side of the tracks.

items.name: West of the north-east corner
items.howTo: West of the north-east rabbit, on the south-east side.

items.name: North
items.howTo: West of the rabbit north of the eastern islands, on the north side.

items.name: North of Papuchia Village
items.area: Line to the Tower of Spirits
items.howTo: Directly north of Papuchia Village where the tracks start turning north, on the west side.

items.name: By the Ocean Realm border
items.howTo: Take the tracks Orca's Force Gem adds, heading north from the Ocean Realm bridge; the rabbit is right at their east end, north of the line.

items.name: East of Whittleton
items.howTo: Further west along the same tracks from Orca's Force Gem, east of Whittleton, north of the line.

items.name: Far west
items.howTo: West of Rabbitland Rescue on the tracks Mona's Force Gem adds: through the woods, where the area opens out, on the east side.

items.name: West of the Forest Sanctuary
items.howTo: Seconds after the previous one, on the south side of the tracks, west of the Forest Sanctuary.

items.name: West of the Goron Target Range
items.howTo: Just west of the Goron Target Range, behind a boulder on the east side.

items.name: Far north
items.area: Between the Target Range and Goron Village
items.howTo: From Goron Village go west, then north past the first intersection and right at the next: on the west (left) side, far up north.

items.name: Far north, further east
items.howTo: East of the previous rabbit, where the tracks turn west then south, on the north-east side.
items.notes: The sources describe this area loosely; Zelda Wiki's prerequisites suggest it's on tracks Embrose's duet adds.

items.name: Fire–Sand border
items.area: South of the Goron Target Range
items.howTo: On the tracks the Mega Ice Goron's Force Gem adds south of the Goron Target Range: where they turn west, at the south-east corner.

items.name: South of the Tower of Spirits
items.howTo: Head south from the Tower of Spirits onto the tracks Lucia's Force Gem adds and turn west: on the south side.

items.name: West of the Pirate Hideout
items.howTo: At the short stretch Lucia's Force Gem adds into the Ocean Realm from the Forest Realm, on the south-west side.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's rabbit page also lists Niboshi's gem; Zelda Wiki and the walkthrough need only Lucia's.

items.name: South of Snowdrift Station
items.howTo: On the tracks Yeko's Force Gem adds in the north-west, south of Snowdrift Station on the north side.

items.name: South-west of the Fire Temple
items.howTo: From the Fire Temple head south, west, south and west: on the north side.

items.name: North of the Fire Temple
items.howTo: Directly north of the Fire Temple, on the south side of the tracks.

items.name: North-east of the Fire Temple
items.howTo: At the far north-east of the Fire Temple's track maze, on the south-west side.

items.name: South-east of the Fire Temple
items.howTo: South of the previous rabbit, near the south-east of the maze, on the south-east side.

items.name: On the line from the Tower
items.area: Tower of Spirits to Fire Realm
items.howTo: On the tracks from the Tower of Spirits into the Fire Realm, east of the line.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki: after the Fire Seal. Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough finds it after the Fire Temple, on the new tracks towards the tower.

items.name: North-west of Wellspring Station
items.howTo: On the new tracks just north-west of Wellspring Station, on the west (left) side.
items.after: Force Gem: Goron visits Anouki Village

items.name: North of Wellspring Station
items.howTo: Just past the intersection north of the previous one, on the east side; Warp Gate D is straight ahead.
items.after: Force Gem: Goron visits Anouki Village

items.name: East of Disorientation Station
items.howTo: East of Disorientation Station; it's on the south or north side depending on which track you take.
items.after: Force Gem: Goron child in Castle Town

items.name: Middle of the Ocean Realm
items.howTo: At the south end of the tracks Wadatsumi's Force Gem adds in the middle of the realm.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's Force Gem page lists Wadatsumi's rabbit as Ocean Rabbit 10; its rabbit page and Zelda Wiki make it 9.

items.name: North of the Sand Sanctuary
items.howTo: North of the Sand Sanctuary, on the north side of the tracks.

items.name: Far west of the Sand Sanctuary
items.howTo: Far west of the Sand Sanctuary, on the south-west side.

items.name: South of the Sand Sanctuary
items.howTo: South of the Sand Sanctuary, on the east (south-east) side.

items.name: East of the Sand Sanctuary
items.howTo: Far east of the Sand Sanctuary, on the south side.

items.name: Forgotten Tunnels: upside-down T, west
items.howTo: In the upside-down-T section of the Forgotten Tunnels, on the west side just south of the tracks.

items.name: Forgotten Tunnels: upside-down T, east
items.howTo: In the upside-down-T section, on the east side just north of the tracks.

items.name: Forgotten Tunnels: T section
items.howTo: In the T-shaped section, in the middle on the east side of the tracks.

items.name: North-east of the Sand Temple
items.howTo: On the line to the Sand Temple, north-east of it, on the south side.

items.name: West of the Sand Temple
items.howTo: West of the Sand Temple, on the west side of the tracks.

items.name: West of Ends of the Earth Station
items.howTo: Where the tracks Rael's Force Gem adds begin, west of the Ends of the Earth Station, on the north side.

items.name: By the Lost at Sea Station
items.howTo: Just west of the Lost at Sea Station in the south-east, east of the tracks.

sections.title: Bunnio's rewards
sections.note: At Rabbitland Rescue. He also pays Rupees for every rabbit.

items.name: Five rabbits
items.howTo: Bring Bunnio any five rabbits.

items.name: One of each kind
items.howTo: Bring Bunnio at least one rabbit of each of the five kinds.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon: a rare Treasure. Zelda Wiki: a random Treasure, for 10 rabbits in all or one of each kind.

items.name: All 10 Grass Rabbits
items.howTo: Bring Bunnio all ten Grass Rabbits from the Forest Realm.

items.name: All 10 Snow Rabbits
items.howTo: Bring Bunnio all ten Snow Rabbits from the Snow Realm.

items.name: All 10 Ocean Rabbits
items.howTo: Bring Bunnio all ten Ocean Rabbits from the Ocean Realm.

items.name: All 10 Mountain Rabbits
items.howTo: Bring Bunnio all ten Mountain Rabbits from the Fire Realm.

items.name: All 10 Desert Rabbits
items.howTo: Bring Bunnio all ten Desert Rabbits from the Sand Realm.

items.name: All 50 rabbits
items.howTo: Bring Bunnio every rabbit.
items.notes: Also in Items & Equipment. Needed for speedrun.com's 100%.
